deck: REMOVE MOLD PHYSICALLY, HOLD -5 PA, AND CLOSE DRYING FILES ON MONITORED READINGS
WRITE, DOCUMENT, AND DEFEND EVERY LINE ITEM FROM XACTIMATE TO THE NEGOTIATION TABLE
site_ui.lead: Working restorers show how they hold containment at -5 pascals, prove dryness with the same meter from start to finish, and price every truck roll at $400 to $500 or more, then carry that discipline through Xactimate line items, roof supplements, adjuster negotiations, TPA programs, and assignment-of-benefits fights.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, from IICRC S500 and S520 field mechanics to mitigation billing, Xactimate, roof supplementing, adjusters, TPAs, fire and contents documentation, plumber referrals, company launch, assignment of benefits, claim law, and storm roofing. Every claim, metric, pro-tip, and operator gate carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner and video it came from.

flow: Make at least $400-$500 every time the truck rolls, set a $2,000 floor on small cash-pay jobs, and require a deposit and a thirds payment schedule before self-pay mitigation starts.

Seal 6 mil fire-retardant poly and confirm -5 pascals on a manometer before any demolition or air movers, never draw negative air from a crawlspace, and remove mold physically instead of fogging or bleaching it.

Extract water from the top of the floor and from underneath before mats go down, place 12-16 air movers for a 750 sq ft loss, take readings every 5 ft, and close the file on monitored readings from the same meter, not on fan-days.
Reconcile billed equipment against photos and equipment logs, write F9 notes explaining each charge, quantity, and duration, and get written owner authorization for any deviation from the standard.
Run one locked naming, bundling, and pricing protocol on every claim using saved templates, and change your pricing, never your scope, by never writing work the crew did not do.
Stop negotiating line by line: have the adjuster tally the attempted reductions, then offer a streamline discount capped at 10 percent in exchange for immediate payment.
